player_prompt.intro:
Iwe ndiwe Mutambo {player_id} mu**Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Tumira zvitendo zvako kwa njira ya **[macro  micro]** (namba mbiri 0-8):
• *macro*  = ipi mini-bhodi iwe unotamba
• *micro* = ipi skweya ndani ya mini-bhodi iyo
Mfano `[7 8]` ➜ weka chapa yako mu mini-bhodi 7, skweya 8, uye
laza mutambo wako kutamba mu mini-bhodi 8 inotevera.

Iwe ndiwe `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kufambisa kunofanira kuva muchimiro [macro micro] nenhamba 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Nhamba dzose dzinofanira kuva pakati pe0 ne8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Micro_board, row kana col iri kunze kwechikuva.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Mutambi wacho anofanira kutamba mubhodhi duku rinotevera.

game_action.played: Muzinda {player_id} akashanda mu micro board {macro_idx}, seli {micro_idx} (row {row}, col {col}). Muzinda {opponent_id} anoziva kushanda mu {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Mutambi {player_id} anokunda Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
